description: Fetch Instagram's Reels feed (instagram.com/reels/) — the algorithmic short-video stream. Returns reel cards with author, caption, like/comment/share counts, and video URL; paginates internally up to 100 items, partial=true when the stream stalls. This is a list command: to read a reel's comments, pass its URL to instagram/get-post (reels are structurally posts). Requires a logged-in Instagram session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of reels to return (1-100, default 20). Paginates internally; partial=true when the feed stalls.
